run_command: python main.py --db feedback.db create-form sample_form.json && python main.py --db feedback.db report 1

api: class Question(text: str, qtype: str = 'rating', options: list[str] = [], required: bool = True, id: int | None = None)
class FeedbackForm(title: str, description: str = '', questions: list[Question] = [], active: bool = True, id: int | None = None)
class Response(form_id: int, answers: dict[int, object], channel: str = 'web', respondent_email: str | None = None, submitted_at: datetime = now)
def validate_response(form, answers, channel='web', respondent_email=None) -> dict[int, object]
FeedbackStore.update_form(self, form_id, title=None, description=None, active=None) -> FeedbackForm
FeedbackStore.submit_response(self, form_id, answers, channel='web', respondent_email=None, submitted_at=None) -> Response
def build_invitations(form, emails, base_url, sender='feedback@example.com') -> list[EmailMessage]
def send_via_smtp(messages, host, port=587, username=None, password=None, use_tls=True, smtp_factory=smtplib.SMTP) -> int
def bar_chart_svg(data, title, width=600, height=360) -> str
def line_chart_svg(points, title, width=600, height=360, y_max=None) -> str
def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int
